rationale:
We propose adding a rule that flags claims where the incident is an airline fault, the fraud score is low (≤ 0.3), and the amount is no more than $75,000.  In back‑tests, this rule covered 181 training cases and 87 held‑out cases, and it correctly identified claims about 70 % of the time—roughly 26 % higher than the 44 % success rate we see in this same zone without the rule.  The evidence suggests the rule will improve our claim handling efficiency and reduce processing errors for this specific type of claim.

Diff: Previously, All claims < $50k auto-processed. The data shows a pattern, so this proposes auto-processing claims that match: incident_type == airline_fault AND fraud_score <= 0.3 AND claim_amount <= 75000.
